# API Contracts Checklist: SPEC-014 Control-Flow Graphs

## Cross-Surface Parity

- [x] CHK013 Is the shared paging request required to apply independently to deterministic block and edge arrays? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, contracts/cfg-mcp.md]
